title: The impact of computer-assisted learning on students’ cognitive skills: evidence from the “Three Supplies and Two Platforms” programme in China
title_zh: 计算机辅助学习对学生认知技能的影响：来自中国“三个课堂”项目的证据
authors: Wei Liu, Xiaodong Zheng, Jingru Ren, Jingxin Liu, Xiangming Fang
official: 官方在线 2026-07-27 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This paper evaluates the impact of the Three Supplies and Two Platforms (TSTP) programme, a large-scale computer-assisted learning (CAL) initiative in China, on the cognitive skills of lower secondary students. We draw on nationally representative panel data from the China Education Panel Survey (CEPS) and implement a difference-in-differences (DID) strategy to identify causal effects. The results indicate that TSTP increases students’ cognitive test scores by 0.177 standard deviations. We provide suggestive evidence that these gains may operate through changes in teachers’ instructional tools and practices, improvements in students’ learning experiences and learning-related skills, and increased parental engagement. The effects are heterogeneous, with larger impacts observed among disadvantaged students, particularly those with lower baseline achievement and those attending rural schools. In addition, the programme reduces the rural–urban cognitive achievement gap by 0.079 standard deviations. Overall, the findings suggest that large-scale CAL interventions can enhance cognitive outcomes and contribute to reducing educational inequality in developing country contexts. KEYWORDS: Computer-assisted learning Three Supplies and Two Platforms China cognitive skills rural–urban disparities JEL CLASSIFICATION: I21 I24 I28
abstract_zh: 本文评估了中国大规模计算机辅助学习（CAL）项目——“三通两平台”（TSTP）对初中生认知技能的影响。我们利用中国教育追踪调查（CEPS）中具有全国代表性的面板数据，采用双重差分（DID）策略识别因果效应。结果表明，TSTP使学生的认知测试成绩提高了0.177个标准差。我们提供的初步证据表明，这些成效可能通过教师教学工具与实践的变革、学生学习体验及学习相关技能的提升，以及家长参与度的增加来实现。该效应存在异质性，在弱势学生群体中影响更为显著，尤其是基线成绩较低的学生和农村学校学生。此外，该项目使城乡认知成就差距缩小了0.079个标准差。总体而言，研究结果表明，大规模CAL干预能够提升认知成果，并有助于缩小发展中国家背景下的教育不平等。关键词：计算机辅助学习；三通两平台；中国；认知技能；城乡差距 JEL分类：I21 I24 I28

title: Beyond Price: Rights Trading in Strategic Factor Markets
title_zh: 超越价格：战略要素市场中的权利交易
authors: Anparasan Mahalingam, Matthew J. Higgins
official: 官方在线 2026-07-27 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Research on strategic factor markets has largely treated the terms of exchange as price. We argue that many strategic transactions instead divide value through contractual bundles in which payment terms and control rights are interdependent. In university technology licensing, we theorize Rights Trading: contingent payment, future improvement claims, and commercialization scope operate as linked components of the contractual bundle through which surplus is allocated. Using 858 hand coded university–industry licenses, we find that contracts relying more heavily on royalty and milestone provisions grant licensees stronger future improvement claims and broader commercialization scope. The results persist across controls and fixed effects and are directionally consistent with complementary instrumental-variable, event-study, and selection-bound analyses. We further show that this relationship is stronger when university technology transfer offices have greater contracting experience, suggesting that contracting capability shapes value appropriation in strategic factor markets. More broadly, the study shows that value appropriation in strategic factor markets depends not only on what organizations pay for strategic resources, but also on how contracts allocate control over their future development and commercialization.
abstract_zh: 关于战略要素市场的研究，大多将交易条件视为价格。我们认为，许多战略交易实际上通过合同束来分配价值，其中支付条款与控制权相互依存。在大学技术许可中，我们提出"权利交易"理论：或有支付、未来改进权主张和商业化范围作为合同束中相互关联的组成部分，共同决定剩余价值的分配。通过对858份手工编码的大学-企业许可合同进行分析，我们发现更依赖提成费和里程碑条款的合同，会赋予被许可方更强的未来改进权主张和更广泛的商业化范围。这一结果在控制变量和固定效应检验中依然稳健，并与工具变量、事件研究和选择边界分析的补充检验方向一致。我们进一步发现，当大学技术转移办公室拥有更丰富的合同经验时，这种关系更为显著，表明合同能力塑造了战略要素市场中的价值获取。更广泛而言，本研究揭示了战略要素市场中的价值获取不仅取决于组织为战略资源支付的价格，还取决于合同如何分配对其未来开发和商业化的控制权。

title: Common Ownership and Hedge Fund Activism: An Unholy Alliance?
title_zh: 共同所有权与对冲基金激进主义：不洁的联盟？
authors: Zohar Goshen, Doron Levit
official: 官方在线 2024-01-01 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This paper proposes a novel mechanism linking common ownership to anticompetitive outcomes. Common owners promote shareholder-friendly governance policies in their portfolio firms, empowering interventions by activist hedge funds that discourage managers from investing. The cumulative impact of hedge fund activism contributes to anticompetitive outcomes, without collusion between managers. Effectively, and possibly unintentionally, common owners exert monopsonistic power over labor by reducing aggregate investment. Subsequently, the artificially depressed wages result in transfer of wealth to shareholders. While hedge fund activism generally improves social welfare in a competitive equilibrium, it may reduce social welfare under common ownership. The symbiotic relationship between common owners and activist hedge funds can be detrimental to society. The paper establishes a new connection between the rise of institutional ownership, adoption of shareholder-friendly policies, increased hedge fund activism, reduced investment and labor share, and heightened capital market returns.

title: Forces Behind South Australia's Unusual Structural Changes Since 1840
title_zh: 1840年以来南澳大利亚州异常结构变化背后的驱动力
authors: Kym Anderson
source: Australian Journal of Agricultural and Resource Economics
official: 官方在线 2026-07-25 · 来源：RSS
abstract: The agricultural sector's share of GDP in growing economies typically declines but, for a century from the early 1850s, Australia's did not. That trend is most evident for the former colony and now State of South Australia (SA). Moreover, that share for SA has been almost flat since 1980 as well, along with the agricultural sector's share of SA exports. This paper seeks to shed light on the forces behind the unusual evolution of these sectoral shares for SA both up to 1950 and since 1980. The extensive time series data compiled for this paper suggest various partial explanations. For 1850–1950, they include the huge arable land area per worker, clearly defined and enforced property rights in settled rural areas as the frontier of European settlement expanded, the absence of a need to do any processing of the main 19th century exports (copper, wool and wheat), a strong public agricultural research and extension system, and the absence of major mining booms after the copper finds in the 1840s and 1860s.
abstract_zh: 在经济增长过程中，农业部门占GDP的比重通常会下降，但从19世纪50年代初开始的一个世纪里，澳大利亚的这一比重并未下降。这一趋势在前殖民地、现南澳大利亚州（SA）表现得最为明显。此外，自1980年以来，南澳大利亚州农业部门占GDP的比重以及农业部门占该州出口的比重几乎保持平稳。本文旨在揭示南澳大利亚州在1950年之前及1980年之后这些部门份额异常演变的驱动因素。本文编制的大量时间序列数据提供了多种局部解释。对于1850年至1950年期间，这些因素包括：人均可耕地面积巨大；随着欧洲定居前沿的扩展，定居农村地区明确界定并有效执行的产权；19世纪主要出口产品（铜、羊毛和小麦）无需任何加工；强大的公共农业研究与推广体系；以及19世纪40年代和60年代铜矿发现后未出现重大矿业繁荣。

title: Covered Interest Parity in Emerging Markets: Measurement and Drivers
title_zh: 新兴市场中的抛补利率平价：测度与驱动因素
authors: Dao, Mai Chi, Gourinchas, Pierre-Olivier
official: 官方在线 2026-07-20 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: We study the behavior of Covered Interest Parity (CIP) deviations - aka the CIP basis - in Emerging Markets (EM). A major challenge in computing the CIP basis in EM's lies in measuring local currency interest rates which are free of local credit risk. To do so, we construct a â€˜purified' CIP basis for eight major EM currencies using supranational bonds issued in EM local currencies and US dollar going back twenty years. We show that this â€˜purified' CIP basis aligns well with theory-implied predictions. In the cross-section and the time-series, the basis correlates with fundamental forces driving supply and demand for dollar forwards. Shocks to global dollar funding costs, global intermediary's balance sheet capacity, and the demand for dollar safe assets interact with currency-specific dollar hedging and funding needs in moving the CIP basis in EM's.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了新兴市场（EM）中抛补利率平价（CIP）偏离——即CIP基差——的行为。计算新兴市场CIP基差的主要挑战在于衡量无本地信用风险的本地货币利率。为此，我们利用过去二十年新兴市场本地货币和美元计价的主权超国家债券，为八种主要新兴市场货币构建了“净化版”CIP基差。研究表明，这一“净化版”CIP基差与理论隐含预测高度吻合。在横截面和时间序列维度上，该基差与驱动美元远期供需的基本力量相关。全球美元融资成本冲击、全球中介机构资产负债表容量冲击以及美元安全资产需求冲击，会与货币特定的美元对冲和融资需求相互作用，共同影响新兴市场的CIP基差变动。

title: Cognitive versus Physical Impairment and the Use and Cost of Long-Term Care in Japan
title_zh: 认知障碍与身体障碍对日本长期护理使用及成本的影响
authors: Rong Fu, Sizhe Liu, Toshiaki Iizuka, Haruko Noguchi
official: 官方在线 2026-07-13 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Japan has the world’s oldest population and a universal Long-Term Care Insurance (LTCI) system, yet how care use and costs differ between cognitive and physical impairment remains underexamined. Using the nationally representative Comprehensive Survey of Living Conditions (2016 and 2019 waves; 324,466 adults aged 65 and older), we compare the utilization, intensity, and cost of long-term care across three groups: those with a dementia diagnosis (defined as regularly receiving medical treatment for dementia), those with physical (ADL) limitations but no dementia, and those with neither. A dementia diagnosis is associated with dramatically higher care use—75.3% receive some care, versus 5.3% of the unimpaired reference group. In models adjusting for demographic and socioeconomic characteristics, dementia raises the probability of receiving formal care by 55 percentage points and informal care by 52 percentage points—roughly double the effects of ADL limitations—and, conditional on use, is associated with about 113 additional hours of formal care per month (some 60% more than physical limitations alone). We estimate formal-care costs at 1.07–4.03% of GDP (depending on the valuation method) and co-residing informal-care costs at 0.79% of GDP. Per-capita formal-care costs are substantially higher for those with dementia (about 3.5 versus 2.0 million JPY annually under the self-reported approach), whereas informal-care costs are nearly uniform across impairment types—underscoring the intensive, and largely invisible, contribution of family caregivers. With the dementia and mild-cognitive-impairment population projected to reach roughly 12 million by 2040, these findings point to mounting fiscal and family-care pressures from cognitive impairment in Japan.
abstract_zh: 日本拥有全球最老龄人口及全民长期护理保险（LTCI）体系，但认知障碍与身体功能障碍在护理使用及成本方面的差异尚未得到充分研究。基于全国代表性数据《综合生活状况调查》（2016年与2019年两轮调查；涵盖324,466名65岁及以上老年人），我们比较了三类群体的长期护理使用率、强度及成本：确诊痴呆症群体（定义为定期接受痴呆症医学治疗者）、存在身体活动能力（ADL）限制但无痴呆症群体，以及无上述两类问题的群体。痴呆症诊断与显著更高的护理使用率相关——75.3%的该群体接受某种形式的护理，而参照组（无功能障碍者）仅为5.3%。在调整人口与社会经济特征的模型中，痴呆症使接受正式护理的概率提高55个百分点，接受非正式护理的概率提高52个百分点——约为ADL限制效应的两倍；且在已使用护理的条件下，每月正式护理时长增加约113小时（较单纯身体功能障碍群体高出约60%）。我们估算正式护理成本占GDP的1.07%-4.03%（取决于估值方法），同住非正式护理成本占GDP的0.79%。按人均计算，痴呆症群体的正式护理成本显著更高（自报法下年均约350万日元 vs. 200万日元），而非正式护理成本在不同功能障碍类型间近乎一致——凸显家庭照护者密集且近乎隐形的贡献。鉴于痴呆症及轻度认知障碍人口预计到2040年将达约1200万，这些发现表明日本因认知障碍面临日益加剧的财政与家庭照护压力。

title: Restoration Responsibility in a Dynamic Game of Deforestation, Production, and Pollution Accumulation
title_zh: 毁林、生产与污染累积动态博弈中的恢复责任
authors: F. E. Ouardighi, G. Gnecco, Eugene Khmelnitsky, M. Sanguineti
official: 官方在线 2026-07-01 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper examines which country should undertake forest restoration when production and deforestation jointly degrade environmental absorption capacity. We develop a two-country dynamic game in which a forest owner derives revenues from deforestation while a non-owner benefits from production; both generate emissions, but only deforestation directly reduces carbon sink efficiency. Restoration is costly and subject to inertia. Consistent with international governance frameworks, the restoring country commits to a predetermined restoration path, while the non-restorer may either commit or retain strategic flexibility. Under homogeneous strategies, long-run environmental outcomes are independent of which country restores. Under heterogeneous strategies, however, the allocation of restoration responsibility becomes crucial: assigning restoration to the producer may aggravate environmental degradation and lead to history-dependent, potentially irreversible dynamics, whereas assigning it to the deforester mitigates opportunistic behavior and promotes more stable outcomes. A novel finding is that history-dependency is both control-specific and parameter-dependent: the deforester’s deforestation and restoration controls exhibit strong Skiba behavior robustly across parametric regimes, while the producer’s emissions exhibit weak Skiba behavior when economically dominant but become more sensitive to initial conditions when the deforester dominates. These results reflect an asymmetry in transmission channels and suggest that robust environmental protection requires aligning restoration responsibilities with forest ownership.

title: Political Fragility: The Economic Impact of Coups d’État
title_zh: 政治脆弱性：政变的经济影响
authors: Luc Tucker & Idrissa Aladji Aya
official: 官方在线 2026-06-05 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: This study uses an entropy balancing model to show that coups d’état can reduce GDP growth by around 2.3 percentage points in the same year. This is a larger effect than some previous estimates, and is found to be persistent over time, reducing cumulative GDP growth by around five percentage points over the following five years. This study goes deeper than previous research into the drivers of that impact, finding that economic sanctions are an an important reason for the observed lower growth in many cases and that the principal channel is via private consumption and investment.
abstract_zh: 本研究采用熵平衡模型表明，政变可使当年GDP增长率降低约2.3个百分点。这一影响幅度大于部分既有研究估计值，且呈现持续性特征——在随后五年内累计减少约五个百分点的GDP增长。相较于既有研究，本研究更深入探究该影响的驱动因素，发现经济制裁是多数案例中增长放缓的重要成因，而其主要传导渠道为私人消费与投资。

title: ASEAN’s Trade and Investment in a Fragmented World
title_zh: 碎片化世界中的东盟贸易与投资
authors: Giovanni Donato & Emmanouil Kitsios
official: 官方在线 2026-06-12 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: This paper examines the short- and medium-term effects of the 2018–19 China-U.S. tariff increases on the trade and investment flows of ASEAN member economies. Using granular trade data, we demonstrate that several ASEAN countries experienced a disproportionate growth in exports of products that were targeted by these tariffs. To further explore the dynamic and often immediate responses of international capital flows to these trade policy shifts, we leverage a novel firm-level FDI database that allows us to identify surges in sectoral investment inflows. Among ASEAN countries, Vietnam stands out as the one where FDI in targeted sectors grew notably faster during 2018–19, likely contributing to its observed export gains over the medium term. At the same time, our analysis reveals that trade gains in targeted products have not universally translated into stronger overall export performance across ASEAN. More generally, while trade reallocation may yield short- and medium-term gains, these gains can be offset over time by the higher long-term aggregate losses associated with trade fragmentation.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了2018-2019年中美关税上调对东盟成员国贸易与投资流动的短期及中期影响。基于细粒度贸易数据，我们证实部分东盟国家在受关税影响产品上的出口呈现非对称增长。为深入探究国际资本流动对此类贸易政策变动的动态即时反应，我们利用新型企业层面外商直接投资数据库，识别出特定行业投资流入的激增现象。在东盟国家中，越南在2018-2019年间受关税影响行业的外商直接投资增速尤为显著，这很可能促成了其中期出口增长。与此同时，我们的分析表明，受关税影响产品的贸易收益并未普遍转化为东盟整体出口绩效的提升。更广泛而言，尽管贸易转移可能带来短期与中期收益，但这些收益会随时间推移被贸易碎片化导致的更高长期总体损失所抵消。

title: Measuring Financial Literacy with the Big Three: Why It Works
title_zh: 用“三大问题”衡量金融素养：为何有效
authors: Tim Kaiser, Annamaria Lusardi, Olivia S. Mitchell, Luis Oberrauch
official: 官方在线 2026-06-15 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: This paper investigates why the widely-used Big Three financial literacy index provides a reliable measure of financial literacy. Using an Item Response Theory framework, we estimate item difficulty and discrimination parameters and conduct a meta analysis to assess the stability of these properties across datasets and countries. Results confirm the scale's validity and reliability, with item characteristics that remain stable across populations and settings. We find no evidence of measurement differences across demographic subgroups or countries. Compared to the longer Big Five scale, the Big Three index performs similarly in measuring financial literacy and predicting financial behaviors.
abstract_zh: 本文探究为何广泛使用的“三大金融素养指数”能可靠衡量金融素养。基于项目反应理论框架，我们估算了项目的难度与区分度参数，并通过元分析评估这些属性在不同数据集与国家间的稳定性。结果证实该量表的效度与信度，其项目特征在不同人群与情境中保持稳定。我们未发现不同人口统计子群体或国家间存在测量差异的证据。相较于更长的“五大金融素养量表”，“三大指数”在衡量金融素养及预测金融行为方面表现相当。

authors: Luca Gagliardone, Mark Gertler, Simone Lenzu, Joris Tielens
official: 官方在线 2026-02-25 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We develop a unified approach to studying cost-price dynamics in the cross-section of firms in order to explain the time series of aggregate inflation, both during normal times and inflation surges. A key novelty is the use of microdata on firms’ prices and production costs to construct an empirical measure of price gaps — the deviation between a firm’s listed and optimal price. We characterize the mapping between price gaps and the size and frequency of price adjustments and take them to the data to test nonparametrically how firms’ pricing strategies align with the predictions of different pricing models, conditional on shocks of different magnitudes. The microdata provide strong evidence of state dependence: the passthrough of costs into inflation increases more than proportionately when the economy is hit by large aggregate shocks. In contrast, in normal times, the frequency of price adjustment is approximately constant, and the microdata conform to the predictions of time-dependent models (e.g., Calvo 1983). Conditional on the path of aggregate cost shocks extracted from the data, a generalized state-dependent pricing model accounts well for both the low and stable inflation of the pre-pandemic period and the nonlinear surge that followed.
abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种统一的分析框架，研究企业截面中的成本-价格动态，以解释总体通胀的时间序列特征，既涵盖正常时期也涵盖通胀激增时期。一个关键创新在于利用企业价格与生产成本的微观数据，构建价格缺口（即企业标价与最优价格之间的偏离）的实证度量指标。我们刻画了价格缺口与价格调整幅度及频率之间的映射关系，并将其应用于数据中，以非参数方式检验企业在不同冲击强度下定价策略与各类定价模型预测的一致性。微观数据为状态依赖性提供了有力证据：当经济遭受大规模总体冲击时，成本向通胀的传导效应会以超比例方式增强。相比之下，在正常时期，价格调整频率大致保持恒定，微观数据符合时间依赖模型（如Calvo 1983）的预测。基于从数据中提取的总体成本冲击路径，一个广义的状态依赖定价模型能够很好地解释疫情前通胀的低位稳定特征以及随后出现的非线性激增现象。

title: The Economics of Litigation Financing
title_zh: 诉讼融资的经济学
authors: Winand Emons, Francesco Parisi
official: 官方在线 2024-10-16 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Third-party litigation financing involves an external party funding a legal claim, taking on the risk of loss in exchange for a share of any potential recovery. As European regulators prepare to establish a common regulatory framework for third-party litigation financing, this article draws on existing law and economics literature to examine the unique characteristics of third-party litigation financing, vis-a-vis other forms of financial support of litigation. Our findings highlight the strengths and weaknesses of different litigation-financing mechanisms in promoting socially desirable levels of litigation, adding a political economy perspective to the ongoing debates on the issue.
abstract_zh: 第三方诉讼融资是指由外部方资助法律索赔，承担败诉风险，以换取潜在赔偿金的一部分。在欧洲监管机构准备为第三方诉讼融资建立统一监管框架之际，本文借鉴现有法律与经济学文献，探讨第三方诉讼融资相较于其他诉讼资助形式的独特特征。研究结果凸显了不同诉讼融资机制在促进社会合意诉讼水平方面的优势与不足，并为当前相关争论增添了政治经济学视角。
